verdict.rationale: The evidence shows webhook event subscriptions (global and workflow-specific) and deployable workflows, but nothing describes a user-defined rule engine that runs actions automatically when events occur. Webhooks only deliver event notifications to a consumer the developer must build, so they are a building block rather than the capability itself. 'Classification rules' and 'split rules' govern document categorization, which is an adjacent feature, not event-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
